scope: Private read-only verification of explicitly selected ordinary image/map files against an exact recorded acquisition plan. Required for current-byte evidence in DE-W034; not a stable public API, worker containment, source-preservation or authenticated custody qualification.
definition: Prepare a new immutable org.disked.acquired-image-verification-definition-prototype/1 with the validated original plan, its digest, and separately observed image/map resources. Each read resource has identity, current epoch, original generation epoch, access=read and exact byte count. The definition digest covers all fields. Reject image/map aliasing, invalid bounds and over-budget map size. Recorded paths remain data and are never followed.
grant: Require the exact definition digest and explicit image_read and map_read booleans before invoking any port. These are caller declarations, not operator authentication. Preparation invokes no port. No creation, write, flush, truncate, repair, resume or replay port exists.
map: Read the private acquisition-record-prototype/2 LF-terminated stream independently of the writer/resume algorithm. Require exact canonical bytes, ordinal sequence starting at zero, SHA-256 predecessor chain, one header, validated matching plan/digest/capture, valid active resource changes, exact current image/map identities and original generation epochs matching the header. Validate pending/checkpoint equality, contiguous bounded ranges, retry/read/substitution rules, read-failure shapes, source/substitution totals and a final full-coverage seal. A torn tail, missing seal or pending range stays incomplete; data after a seal or contradictory records refuse. Never repair the map or replay an effect.
image: Only checkpointed chunks are read. Read each bounded image range once, count bytes actually returned separately from matched bytes, and require exact length plus SHA-256 equality. Zero-fill records must declare a permitted substitution and match the digest of exact zero bytes; matching substitution bytes do not establish recovered source data. A byte mismatch is mismatch; unavailable/short reads are unknown. A fully sealed image must have exact plan length. Keep observed matching prefixes when later checks fail; they do not qualify the complete image.
resources: Bind and revalidate image/map resources before each record and image read and after verification. Final applicability requires unchanged identities, generations, metadata and ancestor paths. Record separate before/after observations and revalidation status. An unavailable or changed resource makes the result unknown, without erasing previously observed counts. No cached fact establishes current worker exit or physical fencing.
counters: records counts accepted canonical records; consumed_map_bytes counts consumed logical record bytes including complete LF separators and an observed torn suffix. covered_bytes and matched_bytes count the contiguous matched checkpoint prefix, with source_bytes and substituted_bytes partitioning that prefix. read_bytes counts bytes returned, including a rejected oversized return when representable. A failed/unavailable read or resource observation never turns the prefix into a complete-image claim.
case_applicability: The native qualification probe separately freezes the selected case revision and its before binding. A later unavailable/changed case binding cannot erase independently observed image/map facts; retain the verification outcome and mark case_revalidation unavailable with no invented after binding. Image matching and applicability to the latest case are separate. Product/custody integration must require an explicitly applicable receipt rather than promoting the old acquisition case/support claim.
completion: matched requires canonical complete sealed map, exact original plan and output generation declarations, full checkpoint coverage, exact current image length, every chunk digest matched, exact map byte accounting and final resource revalidation. This establishes only current held ordinary-file bytes matching recorded declarations during the observation. A map chain authenticates no author; matching bytes are not a source-preservation, point-in-time acquisition, power-loss, actor or healthy-media claim.
windows: Explicit fixed local DOS paths use the existing ordinary-file profile. Hold strong ancestors and GENERIC_READ/FILE_SHARE_READ handles; reject reparse/device/UNC/ADS/offline/nonordinary/hardlinked files. Verify full paths and exact metadata/generations repeatedly. Never reopen or dereference image paths from the map. The initial synchronous private adapter has finite allocation/record/read budgets, not an OS-latency or asynchronous containment guarantee. Bounded same-file worker and all frontend integration remain required before product availability.
qualification: Use actual generated acquisitions plus independent Python chunk/map checks and before/after byte inventories. Exercise current-byte corruption, incomplete/torn maps, record contradictions, substitution, exact plan/output-generation binding, grant refusal with zero port calls, actual held-file sharing/rename refusal and actual metadata changes. Label synthetic map/port faults separately from actual native effects; preserve failed or live fixture dependencies.
